name: Camera offline - basic troubleshooting
user_persona: A non-technical homeowner, moderately frustrated. Camera stopped working yesterday. Not familiar with network settings.
opening_message: Help! My Reolink camera stopped showing up in the app since yesterday. I can't see any video feed. What's going on?

name: Night vision blurry - outdoor camera
user_persona: A tech-savvy user who has tried basic troubleshooting. Provides detailed descriptions. Patient.
expected_resolution: Clean lens and adjust IR settings
opening_message: I've noticed my RLC-820A dome camera has very blurry night vision. During the day it's crystal clear but at night everything looks foggy and washed out. I've already tried restarting it.

name: Motion detection false alarms
user_persona: An impatient user getting too many notifications. Wants a quick fix. Short messages.
expected_resolution: Adjust sensitivity and enable smart detection
opening_message: I keep getting motion alerts every 5 minutes from my Argus 3 Pro. Most of them are just trees moving. This is really annoying!

name: NVR not recording - HDD issue
user_persona: A small business owner who relies on security footage. Very concerned about losing recordings. Detailed communicator.
expected_resolution: Initialize HDD and check recording schedule
opening_message: I have a Reolink RLN8-410 NVR for my store. I just realized there are no recordings from the past 3 days! I need this footage for security. Can you help me figure out what happened?

name: WiFi camera keeps disconnecting
user_persona: A homeowner with limited technical knowledge. Camera is far from router. Cooperative but confused by technical terms.
expected_resolution: Improve WiFi signal or use WiFi extender
opening_message: My wireless camera keeps going offline every few hours. When I check the app it says 'disconnected'. I have to go unplug it and plug it back in to make it work again.

name: SD card not detected
user_persona: A first-time Reolink user. Just set up the camera. Doesn't understand why recordings aren't saving.
opening_message: I just bought a Reolink E1 Zoom and put in a 64GB micro SD card but the app says 'No SD card'. I know the card is good because I use it in my phone. What's wrong?

name: Remote access not working
user_persona: A user who can view camera at home but not when away. Moderately technical. Traveling for work.
expected_resolution: Enable UID and check router settings
opening_message: When I'm at home on WiFi I can see my RLC-823A camera fine, but when I'm at work or using mobile data I get 'Connection Failed'. I need to be able to check my cameras remotely.

name: Firmware update failed
user_persona: A worried user whose camera is now unresponsive after a failed firmware update. Very anxious.
opening_message: HELP! I was updating my RLC-810A firmware and the power went out during the update. Now the camera won't turn on properly - the light just blinks. Did I brick my camera??

name: PoE camera not connecting to NVR
user_persona: A DIY installer setting up a new system. Has basic networking knowledge. Methodical.
expected_resolution: Check cable and PoE port, try different port
opening_message: I'm setting up a new RLC-1210A camera with my NVR. I've connected it via ethernet to the NVR's PoE port but the NVR doesn't detect the camera. The camera's LED isn't on at all.

name: Two-way audio echo
user_persona: A doorbell user who wants to talk to visitors. Non-technical. Friendly.
opening_message: Hi! I love my Reolink doorbell camera but when I try to talk to someone at the door, there's a terrible echo. We can barely understand each other. Any tips?

name: Video quality poor - pixelated
user_persona: A user who recently noticed quality degradation. Compares to how it used to look. Provides screenshots mentally.
expected_resolution: Switch to Clear stream and check WiFi bandwidth
opening_message: The video from my RLC-510WA used to be really sharp but now it looks pixelated and blurry. I haven't changed any settings. What could have caused this?

name: Playback shows green/corrupted frames
user_persona: A concerned user who needs footage for an insurance claim. Time-sensitive. Stressed.
expected_resolution: Check HDD health, possible HDD replacement
opening_message: I need to pull footage from my NVR for an insurance claim but when I try to play back recordings from last week, many of them show green/broken images. I REALLY need this footage. Is there any way to recover it?
